title: Montero Collection 16-Inch Wall Mount Two-Tiered Glass Shelf in Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Organize your vanity space with the Montero 16-inch two-tiered glass shelf, featuring a crisp, architectural design that brings sophisticated storage to modern bathrooms.

  • Space-Saving Storage: Wall-mounted two-tier design provides extra room for toiletries while freeing up limited counter space.
  • Premium Materials: Constructed from high-grade solid brass and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for lasting durability and safety.
  • Clean Aesthetic: Features concealed screw mounting and beveled edges for a seamless look that complements minimalist decor.
  • Designer Versatility: Available in 28 finishes, including unlacquered brass and matte black, to coordinate with any color palette.
  • Coordinated Style: Part of the Montero collection, allowing for a fully unified bathroom design.

Specifications:

  • Material: Solid Brass / Tempered Glass
  • Dimensions: 16" L x 8.3" H x 5.7" W
  • Glass Thickness: 0.38"
  • Weight Capacity: 4 lbs
  • Included: Shelf and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, contemporary design 2-tier glass vanity shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelving unit is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass collection of products, this subtle glass shelf unit is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
